meta.thermal_note: Thermal validation not supported by the provided dataset.

checks.name: RDS(on) at the datasheet test point
checks.condition: VGS = 5 V, IDS = 50 A (VDS = RON*IDS = 0.08 V)
checks.note: Primary calibration point: K is solved from exactly this bias.

checks.name: Drain current suppression at the threshold voltage
checks.note: Datasheet specifies V(th) at IDS = 10 mA; the twin carries only leakage here, far below that test current.

checks.name: Off-state drain current at the IDSS test voltage, 125 degC
checks.note: Upper bound. The twin predicts far below the printed maximum.

checks.name: Leakage temperature ratio, 125 degC over 25 degC
checks.note: The twin applies the printed 60 uA / 4 uA ratio exactly.

checks.name: Off-state gate leakage at 125 degC
checks.note: The twin anchors IGSS at the printed 2 uA / 25 degC value and applies the printed 40 uA / 2 uA = 20 ratio, not the IDSS ratio.

checks.name: Ciss at the datasheet capacitance test bias
checks.condition: VGS = 0 V, VDS = 75 V, f = 1 MHz
checks.note: Cgs0 and Vgsc are solved from this value together with QGS.

checks.name: Coss at the datasheet capacitance test bias
checks.condition: VGS = 0 V, VDS = 75 V, f = 1 MHz
checks.note: Coss0 and Vjc are solved from this value together with Qoss.

checks.name: Crss at the datasheet capacitance test bias
checks.condition: VGS = 0 V, VDS = 75 V, f = 1 MHz
checks.note: Cgd0 and Vjg are solved from this value together with QGD.

checks.name: Qgd at the datasheet capacitance test bias
checks.condition: VGS = 0 V, VDS = 75 V, f = 1 MHz
checks.note: Integrated over the same drain voltage as the printed charge point.

checks.name: Qoss at the datasheet capacitance test bias
checks.condition: Qoss is measured over the drain discharge to VDS = 75 V, not to the 75 V capacitance test bias, so it is not comparable here
checks.note: The twin has no discharge excitation, so this printed value is recorded as unavailable rather than checked.

checks.name: QGS + Qgd at the datasheet gate-charge end voltage
checks.note: The twin satisfies both printed charge components exactly.

checks.name: QG at the datasheet gate-charge end voltage
checks.note: QGS + QGD = 15.5 nC contradicts the printed QG = 34 nC. Any model that matches the components cannot also match QG. QG is corroborated by FOM-QG = QG * RDS(on) = 54.4 nC*mOhm, so the component values are the values treated as suspect.

checks.name: FOM-QG cross-check
checks.condition: QG * RDS(on), arithmetic on printed values only
checks.note: Confirms the printed QG is self-consistent with RON.

checks.name: Saturation drain current at the maximum gate drive
checks.condition: VGS = 5 V, VDS = VDSAT = 1.66303 V, 25 degC
checks.note: VDSAT is solved so the saturation current equals the printed ID,pulse rating at the printed maximum gate drive.

checks.name: Continuous drain current rating
checks.condition: Printed rating, not an I-V point
checks.note: The continuous rating is a package and thermal limit. Every thermal resistance and PTOT in the dataset is TBD, so no model can reproduce it. Reported as unavailable, not as a pass or a failure.

dataset_defects.qg_detail: QGS + QGD = 15.5 nC does not equal QG = 34 nC. QG is corroborated by FOM-QG = QG*RDS(on) = 54.4 nC*mOhm.
dataset_defects.qgd_detail: The QGD test condition VDS = 75 V with IDS = 50 A at VGS = 5 V cannot occur for this device: the twin passes far more than 50 A at that bias. The printed condition must be current limited.
dataset_defects.thermal_detail: Every thermal resistance and the total power rating are printed as TBD. No thermal model is possible.
dataset_defects.curves_detail: The datasheet contains no ID-VDS, ID-VGS, C-V, switching or temperature characteristic curves. Model curves are predictions, not data.
